newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's 11-month oil products demand up 6.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's 11-month oil products demand up 6.3 pct.

text.p: South Korea's oil products demand rose 6.3 percent to 641.1 million barrels in the first 11 months of 1996 from 603.2 million in the year-earlier period, the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy said on Monday.
This compares with a 9.1 percent growth in domestic consumption in the same period of last year.
The ministry said in a statement the oil refiners produced 652.6 million barrels of petroleum products in the first 11 months against 586.7 million a year earlier.
Production increased with the commercial operation of Hyundai Oil Refinery Co's new 200,000 barrels-per-day (bpd) crude distillation unit (CDU) in May and Yukong Ltd's 200,000 bpd CDU in October.
South Korea currently has a refining capacity of 2.44 million bpd.
